title: Lanes write numbered acceptance clauses with edge cases before code and Stop proves each
body:
Why: Fable 1115g slice 2, the most valuable: the specification is the only lever with a large measured effect (D23 PB 62.5% vs P 10.7%); the clauses arm runs only under KRN_ACCEPTANCE_CLAUSES.
Outcome: the clauses arm is on by default; a body with under 2 clauses makes the worker write numbered clauses first including stack edge cases (empty, missing, unauthorised, duplicate submit, non-ASCII); Stop refuses until each clause has a passing test.
Files: src/brain/acceptance-clauses.ts, src/hook/stop.ts, src/cli/lane-run/brief.ts, tests.
Proof: a goal-lane fixture with a one-line goal ends with 3 or more proven clauses; Stop is red with an unproven clause.
Serial: after t-qjqsdvj (same Stop region).
